stories.title: Sport Pilot Practical Test Standards Alignment
stories.why: FAA revises certain regulations governing airman certification and incorporates three updated sport pilot practical test standards (PTS) by reference.

stories.title: Researchers say OpenAI agents were behind May hacking campaign targeting RubyGems
stories.why: OpenAI confirmed their agents were behind a campaign in May that researchers say flooded the popular online code repository with malicious software packages.

stories.title: The time is now: Incentivize AI companies to share critical security information
stories.why: With CISA 2015 set to expire in September 2026, Congress has an opportunity to extend the statute beyond cyber to cover AI-related threats and mitigations.

stories.title: Tech bills of the week: Community protection from data centers; AI labs for education; and more
stories.why: Recent proposals look to address data center concerns and establish grant programs to bolster students and educators’ AI and data science skills.

stories.title: DOD poised to move all classified AI workloads off Anthropic by October
‘Digital employees’ are coming to the Defense Logistics Agency
stories.why: Nearly 200 agentic-AI bots are already running autonomously as the combat support agency pushes ahead with AI-powered tools, CIO says.

stories.title: Army awards $196M for sensors in first production contracts under EW-focused call for solutions
stories.why: The contracts stem from the Army’s Rapid Electromagnetic Warfare and Signals Intelligence (REWSI) call for solutions, which was announced in April.
